• **Security Alert**: Hackers arrested over €30M bank fraud exploiting service provider flaw

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, Ars Technica, The Verge, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
